text:
emma: Who's up for a 12-min lunchtime thing today? Two options: hill repeats (hard) or mobility + foam roll (easy). Vote with 👍 for hill, 🙌 for mobility. 
josh: Hill repeats sound tempting but I have a meeting at 1. Can we do it quick and close to the building?
leila: I vote mobility 🙌 my calves are toast from yesterday. Also foam roller club > suffering.
nikhil: 👍 for hill. Quick repeats up the short service road behind the loading dock — ~80m, low traffic. 6 rounds easy to hard.
olivia: If we do hill I can drive the stroller with my kid, is that allowed near the dock? 609
fitness-bot: Reminder: outdoor group activities of >5 require ops sign-off. Current group count: 4. No sign-off needed.
emma: Nice — so far hill 2, mobility 1. We can pick by majority at 11:55.
josh: If hill, can we do a scaled option: 6 x 40m strides for folks who need lower impact?
nikhil: Yep that'll work. We'll call it: "hard hill" = 6 x full effort 80m, "scaled" = 6 x 40m controlled sprints, rest ~90s.
leila: For mobility option, plan would be 10 min guided stretch + 10 min foam rolling. Bring mat if you want.
emma: Ops note: @seth said no kettlebells near planter boxes. Also pack out any tape/markers.
josh: I'll bring a small cone and a stopwatch app.
olivia: I'll swing by with a mat and baby snacks (just in case).
nikhil: Weather check: looks clear until 12:45 then 20% chance of drizzle. If raining, fallback to Gym Corner C (down the hall).
emma: Poll closing at 11:55. Current quick tally: 👍 hill (nikhil, josh), 🙌 mobility (leila, olivia maybe), leaning hill by one.
leila: I'm fine with hill if it's scaled. Don't want to hobble for Friday.
emma: Final: hill repeats with scaled options. Meeting spot: loading dock entrance at 12:05. Bring water and shoes you don't mind dirt on.
josh: See you there!
fitness-bot: Note: rooftop/roof-access rules do not apply. Have fun and stay safe.
